name: Pattern 14
html:
Solution Approach:

We have to print a multiplication table of given number "x". We run a loop until 10. Saving results of multiplication for print command convenience and write the print command according to the output format.

import java.util.*; public class Main{ public static void main(String[] args) { Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in); int x = scn.nextInt(); for(int i=1;i<=10;i++) { int val = x*i; System.out.println(x + " * " + i + " = " + val ); } } }
java; true";
